verdict.rationale: BigQuery's own Data Transfer Service schedules load jobs on a recurring basis ("batch data transfers at regular intervals"). Dataform, documented as part of the BigQuery ecosystem, lets users "schedule complex workflows for data transformation in BigQuery," so recurring jobs and workflows are both covered. missing for 10: evidence of scheduled SQL queries and schedule configuration details (cron syntax, triggers, monitoring/retries), any AI-native or agent-driven scheduling path, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: you can schedule load jobs. You can schedule one-time or batch data transfers at regular intervals
With the BigQuery Data Transfer Service, to automate data loading pipelines into BigQuery, you can schedule load jobs.
Dataform is a service for data analysts to develop, test, control versions, and schedule complex workflows for data transformation in BigQuery.
